name: Aubergine Kitchen (Mountain View Village Herriman / Lehi) Grilled Salmon or Chicken Bowl on White/Brown Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Aubergine Kitchen (Mountain View Village / Riverton-Herriman & Lehi, UT)
whyItWorks: Aubergine Kitchen cooks 100% seed-oil-free (using only extra-virgin olive oil and avocado oil) with zero refined sugars; a build-your-own bowl with roasted salmon or grilled chicken, sweet potatoes, avocado, and rice is clean and anti-inflammatory.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Build a warm bowl with Grilled Salmon or Free-Range Chicken, roasted sweet potatoes, avocado, and rice—skip raw kale, raw red onions, and lemon-tahini dressing (use plain olive oil and sea salt).
watchOuts: Many house dressings contain lemon juice (citrus trigger)—dress with plain extra-virgin olive oil instead; skip raw kale and chickpea salads
